Fix `packages/element/src/delta.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Gate 3 revise + senior review blocker 1 (U09 never applied; four earlier rounds failed: non-unique search text, edits outside planned sites, malformed reply). Make exactly these three changes, each as one edit whose search text is the exact unique line(s) quoted here, and answer with ONE JSON object {path, edits:[{search, replace}]}:
(1) In `private static stripStandaloneProps(` the line `    const { name, viewBackgroundColor, ...elementsProps } =` must also strip pages and activePageId: replace it with `    const { name, viewBackgroundColor, pages, activePageId, ...elementsProps } =` (keep the next line `      delta as ObservedAppState;`). This stops pages/activePageId reaching the `assertNever(` default branch of filterInvisibleChanges (which logs console.error on every undo/redo touching pages).
(2) Add `import { applyPageChanges } from "./pages";` directly after the unique line `import { getObservedAppState } from "./store";`.
(3) In `public applyTo(` of AppStateDelta, the unique block
`        selectedLinearElement: insertedSelectedLinearElement,
        ...directlyApplicablePartial
      } = this.delta.inserted;`
becomes
`        selectedLinearElement: insertedSelectedLinearElement,
        pages: insertedPages,
        ...directlyApplicablePartial
      } = this.delta.inserted;`
and the unique block
`        lockedMultiSelections: mergedLockedMultiSelections,
        selectedLinearElement:
          typeof insertedSelectedLinearElement !== "undefined"`
becomes
`        lockedMultiSelections: mergedLockedMultiSelections,
        ...(insertedPages
          ? { pages: applyPageChanges(appState.pages, insertedPages) }
          : {}),
        selectedLinearElement:
          typeof insertedSelectedLinearElement !== "undefined"`
so undoing/redoing a page delete applies the changed pages one at a time by id with version + 1 and a fresh versionNonce (applyPageChanges in packages/element/src/pages.ts), never a whole-array replace. Change nothing else.
